nodes.title: Allow uploading a background-removed image before running Remove background
nodes.summary: On each image prompt card in the Image Generation step, let the user upload their own background-removed image directly into the "Background removed" slot, even when no image has yet been produced by the "Remove background" process. Today the background-removed image can only be replaced after "Remove background" has generated one. This goal adds an upload control to the empty "No background-removed image yet" state, saves and displays the uploaded image the same way as a generated one, keeps "Remove background" available as an optional alternative, and keeps the existing replace behaviour working once a background-removed image exists.
